summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K and Material Change Report announcing the retirement of CEO Gordon A. Johnston effective October 1, 2026, and the appointment of Susan Reisbord as his successor. Mr. Johnston will remain as Vice Chair of the Board. Ms. Reisbord, previously COO for North America, joined Stantec in 2021 through the Cardno acquisition. The transition follows a Board-led succession plan. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder votes are involved. The change is effective October 1, 2026. Watch for any strategic shifts under new leadership; no risk-arb angle as this is a routine executive succession.
